title: HAIEC AI Assurance Controls Practitioner Workbook V2: 45-control deep-dive teaching matrix
status: AUTHORING SPECIFICATION ONLY, NOT SHIPPED HTML CONTROL PROCEDURES NOR LIVE CONTROL EXECUTION
teachingUsage: All mechanism, evidence, evaluation, finding and exercise fields are EDITORIAL EDUCATIONAL GUIDANCE, not asserted implemented product adapters/tests. Reconcile implementation and per-customer access before telling anyone to execute.

controls.title: Audit trail completeness
controls.question: Are required audit categories captured under a frozen policy?
controls.mechanism: Check actual required audit-category coverage under a frozen test policy
controls.evidence: Specified required categories, audit receipts, identity/time and exact test scope
controls.evaluation: Compare observed category set to the frozen policy and show missing/extra categories
controls.finding: Incomplete audit trail is bounded to that scenario; not global enterprise logging failure
controls.exercise: Required audit categories are A/B/C, result has A/C; classify missing B

controls.title: Duration anomaly threshold
controls.question: Does measured duration meet the bounded frozen policy?
controls.mechanism: Compare duration measurement against an explicitly defined baseline/threshold and unit
controls.evidence: Frozen duration threshold, measured start/stop clock, units and test ID
controls.evaluation: Recompute test duration using known clock basis and evaluate rule
controls.finding: An exceeded threshold shows scenario anomaly only, not continuous latency monitoring
controls.exercise: Duration 140ms with 100ms ceiling; identify exceeded threshold and unit basis

controls.title: Token expenditure cap
controls.question: Does measured token expenditure satisfy the frozen cap?
controls.mechanism: Measure token expenditure against policy-defined scope and frozen cap
controls.evidence: Token unit convention, source accounting, cap, test interval and evaluated run
controls.evaluation: Reconcile metered input/output tokens for exact interval and compare with cap
controls.finding: Excess tokens indicate a cap result for tested scope, not provider billing accuracy or global spend control
controls.exercise: Test consumed 13k tokens with 10k cap; calculate overage and evidence needed

controls.title: AI estate inventory completeness
controls.question: Which AI systems and agents are actually in scope?
controls.mechanism: Reconcile a declared AI-system estate with bounded agent, source and tool discovery
controls.evidence: Dated inventory, in-scope repositories or integration manifests, discovered identities and owners
controls.evaluation: Compare declared and discovered assets in one specified environment and reconcile exclusions
controls.finding: An omitted discovered agent shows an inventory gap in covered scope, not proof the entire enterprise inventory is incomplete
controls.exercise: Three callable agents appear in source but only two are inventoried; identify the missing record and owner

controls.title: Accountable ownership and responsibility
controls.question: Who is accountable for the AI system and its decisions?
controls.mechanism: Bind material AI choices and systems to a documented accountable owner and reviewer
controls.evidence: System-owner record, responsibility delegation, decision actor and effective dates
controls.evaluation: Select a material action and establish who approves, implements, reviews and responds
controls.finding: Unowned decisions need governance remediation; a name on a chart does not evidence an actual approval
controls.exercise: An incident has three teams and no authorized decision owner; assign roles and required record

controls.title: AI acceptable use and approval
controls.question: Has the use case and operating scope been approved?
controls.mechanism: Check approved use and operating policy against a specific AI action
controls.evidence: Approved policy ID, version, scope, approver, prohibited/allowed operation and decision record
controls.evaluation: Compare one consequential request and its target against applicable policy and version
controls.finding: An apparent out-of-policy path is a candidate until actor, target and policy scope align; documented policy is not enforcement
controls.exercise: A refund agent can choose a new destination while policy permits original method only; classify the concern

controls.title: AI risk and impact assessment
controls.question: What risks and impacts were assessed before use?
controls.mechanism: Establish that a scoped impact/risk analysis covers actual affected resources and decisions
controls.evidence: Use-case risk register, impact owners, assumptions, stakeholders and dated sign-off
controls.evaluation: Check that assessed harms align with concrete action paths and affected populations
controls.finding: A missing covered consequence is a risk-assessment coverage gap, not automatic realized harm
controls.exercise: The risk assessment omits supplier payment changes; identify the update and reviewer

controls.title: Regulatory applicability and obligations
controls.question: Which obligations apply to this deployment?
controls.mechanism: Map legal obligations to actual jurisdiction, use case and target rather than a generic badge
controls.evidence: Deployment jurisdiction, purpose, system classification, applicable requirement and counsel-approved interpretation
controls.evaluation: Test relevance and evidence obligation for one deployment, labeling unestablished applicability
controls.finding: Missing mapping requires policy/legal review; no completed crosswalk certifies legal compliance
controls.exercise: Compare an internal coding assistant with an automated hiring decision for applicability

controls.title: Third-party AI and vendor assurance
controls.question: Are model, provider and upstream risks evaluated?
controls.mechanism: Review upstream model, provider and vendor assurance dependencies for one system
controls.evidence: Vendor/system inventory, contracts, deployment region, data flow, vendor security attestations and review dates
controls.evaluation: Trace one agent action through provider and subprocessors; inspect actual scope and assurance age
controls.finding: Stale or absent vendor evidence limits third-party confidence; it is not proof a breach occurred
controls.exercise: A model provider added a subprocesser after approval; identify affected evidence and renewal owner

controls.title: Change and lifecycle governance
controls.question: Can governance scope be linked to system changes?
controls.mechanism: Link policy/control review to code, model, tool and environment changes
controls.evidence: Commit/release IDs, source snapshot, policy version, approvals and change records
controls.evaluation: Compare baseline and candidate release and decide which control findings need reevaluation
controls.finding: A changed action path with an old approval requires renewed review; historical receipts must not be retroactively changed
controls.exercise: An agent gains a refund tool after a release; choose which approvals/evaluations reopen

controls.title: Privileged tool authorization paths
controls.question: Can privileged tools bypass approved mediation?
controls.mechanism: Check privileged tool handlers for action-bound server-side authorization and mediation
controls.evidence: Tool schema, handler/route, principal identity, permission checks and scoped negative-test proof
controls.evaluation: Trace one privileged API call and test whether unauthorized identity is denied where permitted
controls.finding: Reachable privileged path warrants investigation; code guard existence or handler 200 alone does not establish effective protection
controls.exercise: A delete-record tool is callable with a reused credential; identify guard and bypass test

controls.title: Multi-tenant isolation
controls.question: Are tenant identity and data accesses correctly scoped?
controls.mechanism: Verify tenant identity and resource filters at each consequential read/write boundary
controls.evidence: Tenant/principal binding, server query filters, fixtures for two authorized tenants and negative-test outputs
controls.evaluation: Attempt a consented cross-tenant negative test and compare exact resource identity returned
controls.finding: A cross-tenant fetch is a scoped isolation failure if reproduced; untested candidate path is not a proven leak
controls.exercise: Two tenants share the same tool operation; test that tenant A cannot read tenant B case

controls.title: MCP and tool exposure
controls.question: Are tool capabilities exposed beyond intended authority?
controls.mechanism: Map exposed MCP/tool descriptors against permitted users, resources and operations
controls.evidence: MCP schema, transport authentication, tool ACL, effective grants and audit records
controls.evaluation: Inventory discoverable tools and verify execute permission versus business intent for one actor
controls.finding: Tool discovery or schema declaration does not itself prove authorized execution or an exploit
controls.exercise: A read-only agent sees write_tool; distinguish exposed descriptor from executable privilege

controls.title: Secrets and credential protection
controls.question: Could agents expose or misuse secrets?
controls.mechanism: Trace secrets and credential handling across code, logs, prompts and tool invocations
controls.evidence: Scoped secret findings, token storage policy, rotation records and redacted test traces
controls.evaluation: Look for hardcoded and logged tokens, then verify scope and revocation without exposing credentials
controls.finding: A detected secret exposure is evidence-bound; a clean grep is not proof secrets cannot leak elsewhere
controls.exercise: A masked log includes a partial bearer token; decide whether source qualifies and who rotates

controls.title: Prompt and input trust boundaries
controls.question: Do untrusted inputs cross into privileged instructions?
controls.mechanism: Test whether untrusted content becomes higher-priority instruction or unsafe tool arguments
controls.evidence: Input source, trust boundary, prompt/template, authorization check and consented test record
controls.evaluation: Submit a safe adversarial instruction in a permitted fixture and inspect tool selection/authorization
controls.finding: Prompt-injection susceptibility is bounded by exact tested path; a model refusal is not a universal guard
controls.exercise: A retrieved document tells the agent to change bank details; inspect trust and action boundary

controls.title: RAG retrieval and exfiltration paths
controls.question: Can retrieval cross trust or data boundaries?
controls.mechanism: Trace retrieval permissions, document provenance and egress paths for protected information
controls.evidence: RAG index permissions, tenant labels, retrieval traces, sinks and scoped leakage test
controls.evaluation: Check one retrieval path from protected document through answer/tool output to external recipient
controls.finding: Cross-scope retrieval or exposure needs specific source/observed proof; candidate dataflow is not observed exfiltration
controls.exercise: A public answer cites private customer data; choose evidence needed to confirm origin

controls.title: Secure AI SDLC and build provenance
controls.question: Can source, artifacts and release lineage be established?
controls.mechanism: Bind AI application controls to signed and reproducible build or source release provenance
controls.evidence: Commit SHA, CI attestations, dependency inventory, scanner results and release artifact digest
controls.evaluation: Verify scanned commit matches deployed or proposed artifact and record incomplete build coverage
controls.finding: A passing scanner on another commit cannot support the current release; missing provenance is not a vulnerability verdict
controls.exercise: Compare a scan at commit A with deployment of commit B; identify the verification gap

controls.title: Excessive effective authority
controls.question: Does effective access exceed approved authority?
controls.mechanism: Compare effective technical grants against the approved scope of a protected action
controls.evidence: Approved policy/envelope, principal/IAM effective permissions, environment and timestamp
controls.evaluation: Align exact principal operation target and magnitude before comparing grants with policy
controls.finding: Broader grants indicate excess capability in compared scope; do not infer the agent exercised it
controls.exercise: An API token permits $5k refunds but policy caps at $500; classify grant versus execution

controls.title: Undeclared executable capability
controls.question: Can analyzed code reach an operation outside its approved scope?
controls.mechanism: Trace source-capable operations outside approved limits with exact semantic matching
controls.evidence: Frozen code path, canonical capability mapping, approved policy and analysis frontier
controls.evaluation: Require fully aligned actor, operation, resource and scope before confirming a policy mismatch
controls.finding: Only full semantic match can support a confirmed finding; operation-only difference is candidate context
controls.exercise: Code calls a generic transfer sink; identify whether resource/actor mapping is complete

controls.title: Delegated Action Integrity
controls.question: Does delegated authority cover the intended, granted and observed action?
controls.mechanism: Compare delegated choice, effective grants, source capability and observed actions across nine DAI dimensions
controls.evidence: Qualified policy, actual delegation basis, IAM, code and observed source with validity windows
controls.evaluation: Separate rule-fixed choices from residual discretion and compare relevant dimensions
controls.finding: Missing delegation is not a violation; established broader fact supports only scoped state, not universal safety
controls.exercise: An agent selects a new refund recipient; decide whether rule fixes choice or separate delegation is needed

controls.title: Observed action outside approved policy
controls.question: Was an action observed beyond its approved envelope?
controls.mechanism: Check observed action against the exact applicable approved operating envelope
controls.evidence: Time-bound observed action, principal identity, policy version and approved limits
controls.evaluation: Match actor/action/target/amount/time and record whether observation exceeds established envelope
controls.finding: A qualified outside-policy observation is more than capability exposure but still may not show final target effect
controls.exercise: A log reports out-of-limit refund API call; distinguish invocation from completed payout

controls.title: Agent and principal identity continuity
controls.question: Is the runtime principal authoritatively bound to the agent?
controls.mechanism: Correlate agent identity and executing principal across credentials and action events
controls.evidence: Agent-to-principal binding, service account identity, trace/action refs and validity
controls.evaluation: Verify exact principal used on the consequential call and account for credential switches
controls.finding: Broken binding limits authority attribution; a service account name alone is not proof of the AI actor
controls.exercise: The agent uses a shared token; explain what identity evidence is missing

controls.title: Human approval and mediation integrity
controls.question: Was required human authorization applied at the action boundary?
controls.mechanism: Check that required human approval is bound to the exact protected action before dispatch
controls.evidence: Approval record, reviewer permission, action digest, time validity, mediation and dispatch evidence
controls.evaluation: Compare request with approved amount, target and version; inspect whether the guard actually intercepted
controls.finding: Approval existence alone does not establish action-bound enforcement or target-side denial
controls.exercise: Approval covers vendor A and agent selects vendor B; select the next evidence/test

controls.title: Least privilege and unused grants
controls.question: Do granted privileges exceed required capabilities?
controls.mechanism: Identify unused or excessive privileges relative to established necessary code capabilities
controls.evidence: IAM grant set, relevant code capability/reachability, known operating need and time basis
controls.evaluation: Compute the meaningful surplus within identical principal/target scope, then propose narrowed permissions
controls.finding: Unused privilege is a least-privilege finding in scope, not evidence it was abused
controls.exercise: Agent needs read_orders but holds delete_orders; choose least-privilege remediation

controls.title: Cross-agent delegation propagation
controls.question: Was authority preserved across A2A handoffs?
controls.mechanism: Check authority constraints through parent-agent to child-agent handoff boundaries
controls.evidence: Verified delegator/delegatee identity, handoff scope, action correlation and expiration
controls.evaluation: Inspect one exact handoff and narrow its operation, target and duration, noting missing joins
controls.finding: Broken or absent lineage is a bounded delegation concern, not universal cross-agent effect proof
controls.exercise: Agent A instructs agent B using broader cloud role; list missing lineage facts

controls.title: Action lifecycle and side-effect traceability
controls.question: Can request, authorization and applied effect be reconciled?
controls.mechanism: Connect request, authorization, dispatch, provider acceptance and actual target-side effect
controls.evidence: Correlation IDs, request/decision log, dispatch receipt, provider response and independent target record
controls.evaluation: Reconcile each hop for the same action and time, explicitly marking unobserved hops
controls.finding: An API 200 or tool call does not prove the business record changed
controls.exercise: Payment tool returns 200 but no ledger readback; identify last established stage

controls.title: Consequential effect envelope
controls.question: Were measured side effects within approved magnitude and scope?
controls.mechanism: Compare actual or qualified candidate consequences with approved operation/resource/magnitude bounds
controls.evidence: Approved effect envelope, scoped effects record, unit/currency and target witness quality
controls.evaluation: Check limit, recipient, resource and observed/witnessed quantity on comparable sources
controls.finding: Excess scoped effect requires qualified measurement; missing witness makes target effect unassessed
controls.exercise: Approved transfer $500 but target record says $900; evaluate bound and provenance

controls.title: Runtime guardrail enforcement evidence
controls.question: Did a declared guardrail actually enforce a decision?
controls.mechanism: Verify runtime guard intervention at action boundary rather than existence of a rule
controls.evidence: Policy version, PEP connection, decision and denial record, dispatch/no-bypass proof
controls.evaluation: Trigger approved negative case and check decision, interception and independent target absence
controls.finding: Configured deny is not proof of actual blocking; classify NOT_WIRED or insufficient witnesses precisely
controls.exercise: Guard reports deny while dispatch logs a write; identify control inconsistency

controls.title: Emergency intervention effectiveness
controls.question: Did a kill-switch action actually stop execution?
controls.mechanism: Confirm emergency stop interrupts the intended protected action flow
controls.evidence: Authorized trigger, control scope, stopped dispatch/queue and target-effect witness
controls.evaluation: In a permitted environment, trigger stop and prove no downstream continuation within tested window
controls.finding: Kill-switch invoked does not prove effective containment of in-flight or bypass traffic
controls.exercise: Queued action executes after emergency stop; document test failure boundary

controls.title: Recovery and resumption authorization
controls.question: Was recovery governed and attributable?
controls.mechanism: Authorize resumption with explicit conditions, identity, state reconciliation and recovery proof
controls.evidence: Recovery approval, incident timeline, remediation evidence, current guard/policy and restart receipt
controls.evaluation: Check who lifted the halt, what changed, whether pending actions were reviewed and state restored
controls.finding: Reopening execution without verified conditions is a recovery-governance concern, not itself a proven new incident
controls.exercise: Following a hold, operator resumes agent with stale policy; identify prerequisites before recovery

controls.title: AI incident response and recovery
controls.question: Can material AI incidents be investigated and recovered?
controls.mechanism: Map detected AI incidents into accountable investigation, containment, recovery and learning
controls.evidence: Alert source, triage/case record, delivery versus acknowledgment, owner, response chronology
controls.evaluation: Trace one incident from first qualified signal to named human action and verified closure
controls.finding: Alert delivery is not human ACK; untested response plan does not establish successful containment
controls.exercise: A notification was sent but no reviewer acknowledged it; decide response state

controls.title: Continuous runtime monitoring
controls.question: Are sources sufficiently complete to detect relevant events?
controls.mechanism: Confirm runtime sources are fresh and sufficient for the specific relevant action window
controls.evidence: Configured producer and cadence, qualified receipt age, identity coverage and event sample
controls.evaluation: Compare freshness to declared cadence and map protected action coverage gaps
controls.finding: Historical signal is STALE and missing events are not proof no action occurred
controls.exercise: Yesterday's OTLP trace exists, last scheduled receipt missing; classify monitoring status

controls.title: Prompt-injection resistance under test
controls.question: How does the system respond to scoped adversarial prompts?
controls.mechanism: Run bounded adversarial tests against prompt injection with reproducible evaluation criteria
controls.evidence: Model/version, prompt corpus, attack entry point, harness, response and exact expected behavior
controls.evaluation: Repeat scoped test and record policy/tool boundary, not just response text
controls.finding: Passing a prompt set shows tested resistance only, not universal immunity
controls.exercise: One injection case fails but ten pass; state numerator, failure and retest owner

controls.title: Sensitive output leakage
controls.question: Did tested responses expose protected information?
controls.mechanism: Test whether generated outputs or tool responses reveal protected values
controls.evidence: Allowed test data labels, prompts, response artifacts and classification/checker basis
controls.evaluation: Check exact covered outputs against sensitive-data criteria with false-positive review
controls.finding: A confirmed leak is bounded to tested output; absence in small set is not comprehensive exfil protection
controls.exercise: Agent summarizes customer tickets and includes SSN-like test string; qualify the event

controls.title: Hallucination risk and grounding
controls.question: What evidence supports content grounding reliability?
controls.mechanism: Evaluate grounding and factual support against trusted reference corpus
controls.evidence: Approved reference facts, answer samples, scoring rubric and model build
controls.evaluation: Test cited claims and categorize unsupported or contradicted answers
controls.finding: Unverified statement can be a hallucination risk indicator, not proof every output unreliable
controls.exercise: Agent asserts a nonexistent purchase order; identify the ground-truth reference check

controls.title: Unsafe output risk
controls.question: What harmful-output risks were detected in tested scenarios?
controls.mechanism: Test harmful-output policy criteria in a defined deployment context
controls.evidence: Risk taxonomy, user cohort/use case, consented test prompts, actual responses and judgments
controls.evaluation: Assess representative risk cases with documented human review where judgment subjective
controls.finding: One test failure supports bounded harmful-output concern; no blanket guarantee of model safety
controls.exercise: Evaluate a harmful instruction request and classify actual response against stated policy

controls.title: Structured output and consistency
controls.question: Do generated responses meet a specified output contract?
controls.mechanism: Check schema adherence and response consistency for downstream tool contracts
controls.evidence: Output schema/version, evaluated samples, parser rejection behavior and dependent action path
controls.evaluation: Run valid/invalid output cases and verify consumers reject malformed consequential values
controls.finding: Schema failure can enable unsafe downstream action if mapped, but one malformed output is not always executed harm
controls.exercise: An agent omits required approval field in JSON; test server rejection

controls.title: Evidence integrity and provenance
controls.question: Can we verify evidence origin, binding and modification?
controls.mechanism: Bind evidence objects to authenticated producer, scope, timestamp and modification history
controls.evidence: Producer identity, content digest, artifact lineage, timestamps and trust boundary
controls.evaluation: Verify integrity, provenance and exact association to selected AI system/evaluation
controls.finding: A valid hash proves file consistency, not that the upstream assertion was true
controls.exercise: A receipt digest matches but source origin unknown; identify which claim remains unsupported

controls.title: Event stream coverage and continuity
controls.question: Is telemetry coverage complete enough for the claimed window?
controls.mechanism: Measure event-stream completeness over a declared monitored interval
controls.evidence: Expected source cadence and categories, qualifying receipts, gaps, sequence IDs
controls.evaluation: Compare expected versus received intervals, quarantine states and action categories
controls.finding: Gaps or stale batches limit event coverage; zero observed violations is not a clean pass
controls.exercise: A source missed two ten-minute windows; decide whether complete coverage can be claimed

controls.title: Source authority and plane correlation
controls.question: Are identity, system and action joins source-qualified?
controls.mechanism: Require trustworthy identity/action/system/time joins before comparing evidence planes
controls.evidence: Qualified binding keys, principal identity, system/tenant IDs and source basis timestamps
controls.evaluation: Match exact control/system across source records and reject mismatched/ambiguous joins
controls.finding: Same control ID from another system is not proof for selected AI system; no cross-system attribution
controls.exercise: Two agents use A03 but only one result belongs to target system; filter and review

controls.title: Contradiction and source reconciliation
controls.question: Do independent sources disagree or lack reconciliation?
controls.mechanism: Surface contradictions and source disagreement without choosing a favorable record
controls.evidence: Independent policy/grant/event records, version/time and conflict provenance
controls.evaluation: Identify conflicting claims, exclude stale versions and request the authoritative discriminating source
controls.finding: Conflicting sources are an unresolved evidence issue, not arbitrary PASS or violation
controls.exercise: Policy says allow to vendor A while signed approval says vendor B; identify exact conflict

controls.title: Independent deterministic replay
controls.question: Can another verifier reproduce the exact frozen result?
controls.mechanism: Reproduce a frozen deterministic conclusion from exact inputs and code/version
controls.evidence: Frozen bundle, run/version/source IDs, expected digest and trusted replay result
controls.evaluation: Replay a persisted native result in exact AI system and control scope, compare artifacts
controls.finding: Replay consistency proves reproducibility of recorded computation, not total real-world accuracy
controls.exercise: Replay digest matches but runtime effects absent; state what replay can and cannot prove

controls.title: Bias and fairness evaluation coverage
controls.question: Were affected groups and relevant harms assessed?
controls.mechanism: Assess fairness coverage and measured outcomes for relevant protected or affected cohorts
controls.evidence: Authorized evaluation dataset, cohort applicability, metric definitions and confidence/coverage
controls.evaluation: Compute per-cohort results with appropriate denominators and report underrepresented or excluded groups
controls.finding: Missing cohort coverage does not establish fairness; measured disparity requires qualified metric interpretation
controls.exercise: Hiring model evaluated only group A; identify minimum additional coverage question

controls.title: Transparency and explainability
controls.question: Can users and owners understand reasons and limitations?
controls.mechanism: Make system operation, decisions, limitations and evidence accessible to proper stakeholders
controls.evidence: User notice, explanation of decision/action, provenance, audience and review feedback
controls.evaluation: Inspect explanation for exact outcome and known limitations, and test whether responsible users can understand it
controls.finding: A generic model card does not explain a specific consequential decision or prove transparent operation
controls.exercise: Customer asks why claim denied; check evidence-grounded explanation and owner

controls.title: Training data governance and lineage
controls.question: Is training data provenance established and reviewable?
controls.mechanism: Trace relevant training data origins, rights, transforms and version into model artifact
controls.evidence: Dataset provenance, transformation log, model version, consent/licensing and retention scope
controls.evaluation: Trace one model release back through data source changes and unresolved segments
controls.finding: Unattributed training data limits lineage assurance but is not a proven misuse without further evidence
controls.exercise: Model updated after dataset merge with no source digest; identify missing lineage and review owner
